items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: headed by a man named Richard McNeil

ctx.x: Well what were some of the big bands in New Orleans in the 30's?
Sidney Desby and Papa Celestan, the sunny southern Senko Piers, headed by a man named Richard McNeil. Clowns doesn't do them, he was in and out of here, so he was in and out of here.
